=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20194-20290 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In persist_orch_wave_check, the red|timeout branch writes wave_check_judged and wave_check_judged_at before the wave judge has given a verdict. If the judge then fails (prepare_tracking_judge_checkout failure at 31828-31830, rc 77 isolation unavailable at 32160-32164, JUDGE_SUCCESS != true at 32165-32170, or empty or unparseable JUDGE_JSON at 32177-32182), the fields stay set. The next tick on the same head and outcome hits judged_hold and `continue` at 31707.
  WHY: A transient judge failure freezes the wave boundary for PERSIST_ORCH_WAVE_CHECK_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES (90 minutes by default) with no retry. The only log line is `reason=judged_recently`, and the red-path test covers only the case where the judge succeeds. All four reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:31680-31689 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a stuck incomplete-wave tick (INVOKE_JUDGE_FOR_STUCK=true), the `_persist_orch_wave_check_clear stale` cleanup at 31686 is skipped. The previous boundary's wave_check_wait_since, wave_check_wait_head and wave_check_judged fields can then survive.
  WHY: The stale wait clock suppresses the boundary_first_seen hold (20105-20127). The next boundary can then get an immediate false timeout, a recently-judged hold, or a premature green advance. Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini rated it BLOCKER and glm rated it MAJOR, so the higher rating is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly checked and rejected this claim: it says the branch falls through (31690 to 31693) to persist_orch_wave_check at 31704, and the gate at 20088-20095 clears the fields there.

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Any failure: set INVOKE_JUDGE_FOR_STUCK=true so the existing judge path runs." (P9, docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md)
  expected_change_site: scripts/persist_orchestrator.py, classify_check_runs; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, persist_orch_wave_check
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: classify_check_runs filters failures by --required-names at scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:762-766 (763-766 per luna). The poller passes ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20160-20165 (20163 per luna). A failed check outside that list is therefore not classified as failing and does not invoke the judge. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash both describe this narrowing as an accepted, documented deviation and did not flag it.
- requirement: "API: at most 2 calls per wave boundary per tick." (P9)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, persist_orch_wave_check
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: On a red result with an empty PERSIST_JOURNAL_LOGIN_CACHE, the path makes three API reads in one tick: check runs at line 20160, the identity at lines 20230-20232, and the job log at line 20240. The cache is initialized empty at line 19494. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash both describe this as accepted and documented in the agents fragment, and did not flag it.
- requirement: The judge block includes "one log tail of at most 8 KiB from the first failing check."
  expected_change_site: scripts/persist_orchestrator.py, classify_check_runs and render_wave_check_block
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: classify_check_runs selects the first failing Actions job and the first failing non-Actions summary separately (lines 773-782). render_wave_check_block prefers the Actions log whenever one is present (lines 898-904). When both kinds fail, the block can show a later Actions check's log instead of the first failing check's. Both reviewers rated this NIT, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:persist_orch_wave_check, the red|timeout branch (lines 20274-20285 write wave_check_judged and wave_check_judged_at, then post the state) and the judged_hold check (lines 20194-20205). These interact with the wave-judge failure exits that follow: line 31828-31830 (`prepare_tracking_judge_checkout` fails, then `continue`), lines 32160-32164 (rc 77 "Wave judge isolation unavailable ... retrying next poll", then `continue`), lines 32165-32170 (`JUDGE_SUCCESS != true`, then `continue`) and lines 32177-32182 (unparseable `JUDGE_JSON`, then `continue`). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The judged marker is written and posted when the red or timeout result is classified, before the judge is prepared. On any of the four failure exits, the next tick hits judged_hold and `continue` at line 31707.
  WHY: A transient judge failure freezes the boundary for PERSIST_ORCH_WAVE_CHECK_MAX_WAIT_MINUTES (90 minutes by default). The rc 77 message "retrying next poll" becomes false, and the only log line is `reason=judged_recently`. The red-path test covers only the case where the judge succeeds. Suggested fix: set the judged fields only after JUDGE_JSON parses (after line 32182), or delete them on the four `continue` paths.
- (hardening suggestion) scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:wave-judge failure exits at lines 31828-31830, 32160-32164, 32165-32170 and 32177-32182
  PROBLEM: The wave_check_judged marker persists after a judge invocation that produced no verdict, which suppresses the retry for MAX_WAIT minutes.
  WHY: Suggested fix: before each `continue`, when PERSIST_ORCH_WAVE_CHECK_BLOCK is non-empty, run `jq 'del(.wave_check_judged, .wave_check_judged_at)'` on STATE_FILE. Estimated 8 lines.
- (hardening suggestion) scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:incomplete-wave clear, line 31686
  PROBLEM: With the switch off, this clear logs `reason=stale` instead of the documented `reason=switch_off`, which is cosmetic log drift.
  WHY: Suggested fix: pass `switch_off` when PERSIST_ORCH_WAVE_CHECK_ENABLED is not exactly "true". Estimated 2 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- Verified and rejected (no finding): the pass-1 claim that stale wave_check fields survive a stuck incomplete-wave tick. The reviewer says the branch falls through (31690 to 31693) to persist_orch_wave_check at 31704, where the gate at 20088-20095 clears the fields. Task completeness: none flagged. P9 "All success"/"Any failure" narrowing (plan lines 536-538), the identity read beyond the two-call budget (plan line 541), the copilot-pull-request-reviewer custom_instructions_too_large failure, test_phase_labels_mirror_label_helpers_and_label_is_registered, and the ruff/shellcheck/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py/test_orchestrate_lib.py failures were noted as accepted residuals or not mappable to this diff (5 related items).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
